text: Authentication Overview. The Atlas service accepts signed access tokens issued by the identity gateway. Token Rotation. Access-token signing keys rotate every 24 hours, and the current key identifier is ATLAS-KV-104. Cache Behavior. The service caches validated token metadata for five minutes to reduce repeated verification work. Deployment Notes. Atlas runs in three regional clusters and uses rolling deployments.

Storage Overview. The Borealis database stores customer profile records in replicated partitions. Backup Policy. Full backups run every Sunday, while incremental backups run every six hours. Encryption. Backup archives are encrypted with key BOREALIS-BK-77 before leaving the primary region. Restore Process. Operators restore the most recent full backup and then replay available incrementals.

Queue Overview. The Cirrus worker system consumes asynchronous jobs from a durable queue. Retry Policy. Failed jobs use exponential backoff and are retried at most five times. Dead Letter Handling. A job that fails all retry attempts is moved to the dead-letter queue named CIRRUS-DLQ. Observability. Queue depth and retry counts are exported as monitoring metrics.
